title: 见家长
setting: Shenyang, your partner's parents' flat, Saturday dinner.

steps.narr: Your partner's parents' door. Gift in hand, palms sweating. 😬
steps.zh: 你提着礼物站在对象家门口，手心全是汗。
记住，我妈说啥你都说好。
steps.en: Remember: whatever my mum says, you say yes.

steps.zh: 哎呀，来啦！快进来快进来！
steps.en: Oh, you're here! Come in, come in!

say.en: Greet them both, and hand over the gift: just a little something.
answers: 叔叔阿姨好！一点儿小心意。
阿姨好，叔叔好！这是一点儿心意。
叔叔阿姨好，一点小礼物。
叔叔阿姨好，这是我的一点心意。
say.gloss: Hello, Uncle and Auntie! Just a little something.
say.tip: 一点儿小心意 = just a little something: how every gift is handed over. A partner's (or friend's) parents are 叔叔 and 阿姨.

mistakes.note: Too soon! Until the wedding, they're 叔叔 and 阿姨.

ok.zh: 来就来呗，还带什么东西！
ok.en: You didn't have to bring anything!

miss.zh: 爸，妈，这是我们给你们带的。
miss.en: Mum, Dad, we brought you this.

5.en: Greet them both and hand over the gift, as modestly as you can.
answers: 叔叔阿姨好！一点儿小心意，您二老别嫌弃。
叔叔阿姨好，第一次来，一点心意，不成敬意。
阿姨好，叔叔好！一点儿心意，请您收下。
叔叔阿姨好，一点小礼物，希望您别嫌弃。
5.gloss: Hello, Uncle and Auntie! Just a little something. I hope you won't mind how small it is.
5.tip: 您二老别嫌弃 = I hope you two won't mind how small it is: the modest way to hand elders any gift. 您二老 nín èrlǎo = the two of you, with respect.

key.嫌弃: to turn your nose up at

steps.zh: 来，坐！尝尝我做的菜，合不合口味？
steps.en: Come, sit! Try my cooking. Is it to your taste?

say.en: Praise her cooking to the skies: better than a restaurant's.
answers: 太好吃了！比饭店的还好吃！
阿姨，您这手艺太好了！
比饭店做得还好吃！
阿姨您这手艺，绝了！
say.gloss: It's delicious! Even better than a restaurant's!
say.tip: 比饭店的还好吃 = even better than a restaurant's: 比 A 还 B (never 很 after 比). 手艺 shǒuyì = a cook's skill. 绝了 = unbeatable.

mistakes.note: No 很 in a 比 comparison: 比饭店的还好吃, or 比饭店好吃多了.

ok.zh: 哪儿啊，随便做的！多吃点儿！
ok.en: Oh, go on, I just threw it together! Eat up!

miss.en: Nothing to say? So it's not good.

5.en: Praise her cooking to the skies, and say how lucky you are to be eating it.
answers: 阿姨，您这手艺真是绝了，我今天有口福了！
太好吃了！比饭店的还好吃，今天真有口福！
阿姨您这手艺，饭店都比不上，我真有口福！
阿姨，您做的菜太好吃了，我今天有口福了！
5.gloss: Auntie, your cooking is out of this world. What a treat for me today!
5.tip: 有口福 yǒu kǒufú = lucky enough to eat food this good: a guest's thank-you that's praise as well. 绝了 = unbeatable.

steps.zh: 听说你在上海工作？一个月挣多少啊？
steps.en: I hear you work in Shanghai? What do you make a month?

say.en: Deflect, modestly: you make enough to get by.
answers: 不多，混口饭吃。
还行吧，够花。
嗨，够养活自己。
不多不多，够用就行。
say.gloss: Not much. Enough to get by.
say.tip: 混口饭吃 hùn kǒu fàn chī = just scraping a living: the humble answer to any salary question. 够花 = enough to live on.

alts.en: Or: change the subject: ask about his fishing
answers: 叔叔，听说您钓鱼特别厉害？
叔叔，您最近还钓鱼吗？
听说叔叔是钓鱼高手？
alts.gloss: Uncle, I hear you're a brilliant fisherman?

then.zh: 哟，这你都知道？我跟你说，上礼拜……
then.en: Oh, you've heard? Let me tell you, last week...

then.narr: Twenty minutes and one eight-kilo carp later, nobody remembers the salary question. 🎣
then.zh: 二十分钟后，谁也不记得工资的事了。

ok.en: Haha, modest! Down to earth, this one.

miss.en: Not saying? Can't be much, then.

5.en: Deflect, as modestly as you can: just enough to get by, and you've a lot to learn from him.
answers: 不多不多，刚够养活自己，还得跟叔叔多学习。
不多，也就够花，还得跟您多学习。
混口饭吃而已，以后还得跟叔叔多请教。
嗨，够用就行，还要跟叔叔好好学习。
5.gloss: Not much at all, just enough to support myself. I've still a lot to learn from you, Uncle.

not.note: 不够 says it isn't enough. The modest answer is 刚够: just enough.

5.tip: 还得跟叔叔多学习 = I've a lot to learn from you: the humble turn that hands an elder the floor. 刚够养活自己 = just enough to support myself.

say.en: Accept the third bowl graciously: in that case, you won't stand on ceremony.
answers: 那我就不客气了！
好，那我再来一碗！
阿姨做的，我必须再来一碗！
那我就不客气了，再来半碗！
say.gloss: Well then, I won't stand on ceremony!
say.tip: 那我就不客气了 = then I won't stand on ceremony: how you accept anything offered twice. 再来一碗 = one more bowl.

mistakes.note: One more is 再 zài (again), not 在 zài (at). They sound the same; the keyboard offers both.
不用谢 answers a thank-you. To accept food, say 那我就不客气了.

alts.en: Or: politely refuse: you really can't eat another bite
answers: 阿姨，我实在吃不下了。
我真吃不下了，谢谢阿姨！
我已经吃饱了！
alts.gloss: Auntie, I honestly can't eat any more.

then.zh: 吃不下？是不是不好吃啊？
then.en: Can't manage it? Is it not nice?

then.narr: You eat the third bowl. Of course you do.
then.zh: 你还是把第三碗吃完了。

ok.zh: 这就对了！就跟在自己家一样，别客气！
ok.en: That's the spirit! Make yourself at home!

miss.en: Not eating? So you think my cooking's bad!
Dinner ends early. Three years later, Auntie still brings it up.
miss.zh: 三年后，阿姨还在说这件事。

5.en: Accept the third bowl as graciously as you can: you'll do as you're told.
answers: 阿姨，那我就恭敬不如从命，再来一碗！
恭敬不如从命，那我就再来一碗！
阿姨，盛情难却，那我就不客气了！
盛情难却，那我再来一碗！
5.gloss: Auntie, I'd better do as you say: one more bowl!
5.tip: 恭敬不如从命 gōngjìng bùrú cóngmìng = better to obey than to stand on ceremony: how you finally say yes to an insistent host. 盛情难却 = such kindness is hard to refuse.

key.恭敬不如从命: I'll do as you say (accepting politely)

answers: 阿姨，我实在吃不下了，您的心意我领了。
谢谢阿姨，心意我领了，真吃不下了。
我真的吃饱了，阿姨的心意我领了！
alts.gloss: Auntie, I honestly can't eat any more. Thank you for the thought, though.

say.en: Far too soon. Say so with the idiom: not even the first stroke of the 八 is written yet.
answers: 叔叔，八字还没一撇呢！
八字还没一撇呢！
这个……还早呢，叔叔。
还早还早！
say.gloss: Uncle, we're nowhere near that yet!

not.note: 已经有一撇 says it's already under way. Far too soon is 八字还没一撇呢.

say.tip: 八字还没一撇 = 'not even the first stroke of 八 is down': far too early to talk about it. 还早呢 = early days yet.

mistakes.note: The saying uses 一撇 piě, the falling stroke that starts 八, not 一笔.

alts.en: Or: pass the question to your partner
answers: 这事儿您问小雨吧！
叔叔，您问小雨吧！
alts.gloss: You'll have to ask Xiaoyu about that!

ok.zh: 哈哈哈！好，有文化！来，喝一个！
ok.en: Hahaha! Listen to you, quoting sayings! Come on, drink up!

miss.zh: 不说话就是默认了！下个月就办！
miss.en: Silence means yes! Wedding next month!

3.en: Far too soon. Tell him it's early days: let things take their course.
answers: 叔叔，还早呢，顺其自然吧！
还早还早，顺其自然吧！
这个还早呢，叔叔。
还早着呢，不着急！
3.gloss: Uncle, it's early days. We'll let things take their course!
3.tip: 还早呢 = it's early days yet. 顺其自然 shùn qí zìrán = let nature take its course: a gentle way to close any 'when'.

5.en: Far too soon. Say so with the idiom, and promise he'll be the first to know.
answers: 叔叔，八字还没一撇呢，有消息一定先告诉您！
八字还没一撇呢，到时候一定第一个告诉您！
叔叔，还早着呢，有好消息一定先跟您说！
这个还早，真有那天，一定先告诉您二老。
5.gloss: Uncle, we're nowhere near that yet. When there's news, you'll be the first to hear!
5.tip: 有消息一定先告诉您 = when there's news, you'll hear it first: a promise that closes the subject warmly. 八字还没一撇 = not one stroke of 八 yet.

answers: 叔叔，这事儿我说了不算，您还是问小雨吧！
这事儿我做不了主，您问小雨吧！
叔叔，我说了不算，您得问小雨！
alts.gloss: Uncle, that's not my call. You'd better ask Xiaoyu!

steps.en: At the door, Auntie presses a red envelope into your hand: ¥10,001, 'one in ten thousand'. You're in.
steps.zh: 临走时，阿姨塞给你一个红包：一万零一，万里挑一。
